solution.keyConcept: Equalize All Bases to 2 Before Comparing Powers
solution.en:
Method 1: Convert All to Base 2: 1) $2^K \times (2^2)^{12} = (2^4)^{11} \Rightarrow 2^{K + 24} = 2^{44}$.

Method 2: AB Denominator +1 (1 sec): $+\frac{1}{3}$ more $\implies \frac{1}{3+1} = \frac{1}{4} = \mathbf{25\%}$ less instantly!

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option B (**₹3,500**).
solution.keyConcept: Extract Simple Interest Directly from Final Amount (12.5% × 2 = 25%)

optionTrick.en: 2 yrs at $12.5\% = 25\% = \frac{1}{4}$ SI! So Principal $= 4$, Amount $= 5$ parts ($17{,}500$). Thus SI (1 part) $= 17500 \div 5 = \mathbf{3{,}500}$!
optionTrick.hi: 2 वर्ष $\times 12.5\% = 25\% = \frac{1}{4}$ ब्याज $\Rightarrow$ मूलधन `4`, ब्याज `1`, मिश्रधन `5` भाग ($= 17{,}500$) $\Rightarrow$ ब्याज $= \frac{17500}{5} = \mathbf{3{,}500}$!

steps.en:
1) Total SI rate $= 12.5\% \times 2 = 25\%$, so Amount $= 125\%$ of $P = 17{,}500$.
2) Find $25\%$ directly (one-fifth of $125\%$): $SI = \frac{17500}{5} = \mathbf{3{,}500}$.

steps.hi: मिश्रधन के `5` भागों में से `1` भाग ब्याज है $\Rightarrow \frac{17500}{5} = \mathbf{3{,}500}$ (विकल्प B)!

solution.en:
Method 1: Percentage Amount Equation: 1) Total SI rate $= 12.5\% \times 2 = 25\%$, so Amount $= 125\%$ of $P = 17{,}500$.
2) Find $25\%$ directly (one-fifth of $125\%$): $SI = \frac{17500}{5} = \mathbf{3{,}500}$.

Method 2: Ratio 4 : 5 Direct Division (4 sec): $SI = \frac{1}{5} \times \text{Amount} = \frac{17500}{5} = \mathbf{3{,}500}$ (Option B)!
solution.hi:
विधि 1: मिश्रधन प्रतिशत समीकरण: 1) कुल ब्याज $= 12.5\% \times 2 = 25\% \Rightarrow$ मिश्रधन $= P$ का $125\% = 17{,}500$।
2) सीधा $25\%$ ($= \frac{1}{5}$ भाग) निकालें: $SI = \frac{17500}{5} = \mathbf{3{,}500}$।

विधि 2: अनुपात 4 : 5 ट्रिक: मिश्रधन के `5` भागों में से `1` भाग ब्याज है $\Rightarrow \frac{17500}{5} = \mathbf{3{,}500}$ (विकल्प B)!

Method 2: Oral 8 × 63 (2 sec): Zeroes cancel `800 / 100 = 8`. Simply compute `8 × (7 × 9) = 8 × 63 =` **₹504**!
